7530	[Amatsu, the Eastern Paradise] Amatsu is the first of the countries on Rune-Midgards's eastern island route. You'll notice that its inhabitants are reserved, but once you get to know them, you'll see that they are a welcoming people who value tranquillity and honor above all else. On your visit, we recommend that you visit the wonderful Temple of the Waters, known for being the home of the spirits that have preserved this land. You can also visit the Imperial Palace and see the best of Amatsu's arcHitecture. Be sure to pay your respects to the Emperor of Amatsu who, despite being the most liberal of all eastern rulers, values the honor of foreigners. Also stop by the legendary Hundred-Year Cherry Tree to see the most beautiful plant in all of Rune-Midgards. It blooms all year round, and the locals venture to say that it is sacred. Many a marriage proposal has been made here. Who knows, maybe you'll have the same luck? Don't forget to stop by the Carp Pond, located in the middle of the nobility-themed gardens. These ornamental fish are colored in a strong red, white and black, the symbol colors of Amatsu. [Don't forget to take photos of all these places and show them to your Tour Guide.]	
7531	[Gonryun, the eastern paradise of clouds] Juno is known as the City of Clouds, a true marvel of Schwaltzvalt technology. But there is another cloud city in Rune-Midgards. And this place is Gonryun, the Eastern Cloud Paradise. The city is also known as the City of Philosophers. Being so high in the sky, its inhabitants have a spectacular view of the entire eastern world. Such a view has given its inhabitants an expansive spirit, which has allowed them to make incredible advances in the archipelago. Gonryun's greatest thinker is depicted in the Great Statue of the Philosopher, located in the center of the city to inspire everyone. When you visit the city, you can also see the fantastic panorama from the Mirante. But don't think that this is the only attraction. Visit the Meditation Hill, a favorite meditation spot for people all over the world. You can sit there and get incredible ideas that can change your life. Another must-see is the Miniature City, located to the south of Gonryun. It is said that this city was once inhabited by tiny human beings who worshipped the inhabitants of Cloud City as gods. These little people disappeared a long time ago and remain a mystery to this day. [Don't forget to take photos of all these places and show them to your Tour Guide.]	
7532	[Louyang, the ancestral fortress] Spiritism. This is the strongest feature of Louyang. This ancient city dates back even before the creation of Glast Heim, but constant wars have reduced it to ruins, a mere shadow of its former self. Still, here the warrior spirit and purity are highly valued. There are dozens of fascinating sites in Louyang. The Statue of the Tiger and the Warrior is one of them, and is known for inspiring warriors to do their best in battle. The Hospital is also very famous, as this is where Rune-Midgards's best-known healers come from. There you'll learn that it's not enough to patch up wounds or use potions. To truly heal, you need to purify your spirit and close the wounds in your heart. The Golden Palace is another place of interest, completely surrounded by the Great Wall of Louyang. Just outside the city, you can also visit the Tower of Screams, a place where martial artists train their screams to release their inner strength. [Don't forget to take photos of all these places and show them to your Tour Guide.]	
7533	[Ayothaya, the floating wonder] Is the suffocating day-to-day life of the metropolis killing you with stress? Then Ayothaya is the place to visit. The city is considered a true spiritual retreat, where those seeking ultimate peace of mind can achieve this goal. This is an extremely picturesque place, built entirely on floating platforms in calm waters. The gentle movement will make you feel relaxed. But be warned: before you go there, contact your doctor and get some anti-sickness medication. It is highly inadvisable to vomit in the water, in the fountains and especially in the Serene Statue and Sacred Statue of the Reclining Philosopher. You can spend hours meditating on the platforms, and the calm swaying will take your body and mind on a journey. When you're free of stress, visit the Temple of Ayothaya to find the answers to the questions that plague you. After all that meditation, there's nothing better than stuffing your belly! Visit the Tom Yum Goong Restaurant, famous for its aphrodisiac soups! Don't leave Ayothaya without tasting them! [Don't forget to take photos of all these places and show them to your Tour Guide.]
